verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and payments SaaS platform with a dashboard, an MCP server and an AI assistant, so a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out is a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics, usage tracking, or any opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
